subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should WhatsApp automatically leave only on a verified self-join to a group JID outside `channels.whatsapp.groups`, and should generic join-event or manual-leave APIs be excluded from this first implementation?
rationale: Current code separates group admission from per-sender authorization, and departure is destructive; repository behavior and dependency capability cannot determine the intended authorization boundary or permanent public API scope.

options.title: Narrow self-join policy
options.body: Add an opt-in action for verified self-joins to unconfigured group JIDs plus a narrow owner notification, leaving generic hook/tool APIs for separate design.

options.title: Broader denial-driven departure
options.body: Leave after any group access denial, accepting delayed behavior and the risk of conflating unauthorized senders with unauthorized groups.

options.title: Notification only
options.body: Notify the owner about new WhatsApp group membership but keep departure manual.

recommendation.title: Narrow self-join policy
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in action for verified self-joins to unconfigured group JIDs plus a narrow owner notification, leaving generic hook/tool APIs for separate design.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared ingress/config history and prior review context make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the product and security boundary decision.
